name: Snipleaf · Gremlet #29
description:
A leafcutter ant carrying a leaf ten times its size. Uses it as a blanket at night.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Snipleaf in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
